item.title: Running Worms W.M.D Natively on PikaOS Linux
item.description: How I got the native Linux build of Worms W.M.D running on Debian-based Linux using Steam Runtime libraries and a launch wrapper.

item.title: Fixing PATH issue in VS Code Terminal
item.description: Quick fix for when a CLI tool works in your regular terminal but fails with ‘command not found’ in VS Code’s integrated terminal. The issue is bash’s early return for non-interactive shells, and the fix is moving PATH exports before that return.
